purpose: source-only receipt field contract, not an execution result or runtime schema engine

requiredFields.sources: repository, exact commit, dirty boolean, changed input hashes if dirty
requiredFields.engine: docker or podman, version, connection/context identity, host OS
requiredFields.platform: measured OS/architecture; linux/arm64 remains unverified until run
requiredFields.images: upstream reference and resolved local image ID, base and derived IDs, contract label/version, lineage
requiredFields.profile: default/project and descriptor identity, topology and issuer reachability category
requiredFields.command: exact executable and non-secret arguments, selection and prerequisites
requiredFields.inventory: framework/area, authored definitions, discovered expanded cases, browser/persona repetitions, snapshots and standalone scripts separately
requiredFields.results: pass/fail/skip counts by framework and area, or explicit not-run/unsupported status
requiredFields.checks: fixed check names and passed/failed/skipped/not-run only
requiredFields.cleanup: owned resources removed, failures and cancellation status
requiredFields.coverage: measured report location and percentage, or unavailable

buildInventory: no added packages or test tools
rules: Use a new evidence directory for every run; retain failed results.
A manifest digest is not a resolved local image ID.
Record native CLI/build/runtime failures explicitly; never reuse historical receipts as a current pass.
Protocol-only, fixture-graph and real application acceptance remain separate.
Test totals are not coverage percentages and do not establish assertion quality.
